data.body: S2 6cd0: BLOCK G7 CRITICAL — genuine parent/child conflict. The D6 conformance fix made the child derive trace_id from the active OTel span, which the epic's Out-of-scope explicitly excluded ('no unification of rebar's own OTLP spans with the gateway's records'). Applied realign-to-parent: the PARENT was wrong — the conformance check showed sharing the id is required for the stated goal, not optional. Epic scope narrowed to what is genuinely still excluded (no rebar-owned root span, no traceparent injection); id-sharing moved explicitly in scope with rationale. Re-reviewing S2 then the epic.
